decisions.reason: As the publicly presented flagship product line with multiple models and high sunk investment, its visibility and centrality make withdrawal very unlikely under escalation of commitment.
The continuing education institute builds on the established offer and has received public commitment, so management remains inclined to persist despite possible disappointment.
The analytics dashboard builds directly on the established software and was given a dedicated launch page, indicating enough visible commitment and centrality to keep it.
The complete practice bundle is close to the core established offer and was presented on its own page, so sunk investments and strategic fit favor persistence.

Because the job and practice listing portal is distant from the established offer and was only mentioned rather than prominently launched, escalation pressures are weak and disappointing results can be attributed to poor fit, making withdrawal likely.
